title: チラシ・販促の枠セット
subject_en: Decorative flyer and poster frames for shops with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, thick enough to hold text or a photo. Flat colourful style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: セール・開店・求人・予約受付など、チラシやポスターの用途別の枠12点です。中央があいているので、文字や写真を重ねて使えます。
